  <title id="mc-title">MANUAL. A different kind of focus.</title>
  <desc id="mc-desc">A precision mirrorless camera in graphite metal, with a textured grip, machined lens rings and deep blue optical glass. Eight iris blades close and reopen once every twelve seconds; a cyan focus confirmation precedes a brief shutter reflection. The camera body remains still.</desc>

  <style>
    .manual-camera .mc-iris-blade { animation: mc-iris-cycle 12s cubic-bezier(.42,0,.24,1) infinite; }
    .manual-camera .mc-focus { animation: mc-focus-cycle 12s linear infinite; opacity: .16; }
    .manual-camera .mc-shutter-glint { animation: mc-shutter-cycle 12s linear infinite; opacity: 0; }
    @keyframes mc-iris-cycle {
      0%, 20% { transform: translateY(-12px); }
      45%, 49% { transform: translateY(22px); }
      70%, 100% { transform: translateY(-12px); }
    }
    @keyframes mc-focus-cycle {
      0%, 13%, 28%, 100% { opacity: .16; }
      17%, 24% { opacity: 1; }
      20% { opacity: .35; }
    }
    @keyframes mc-shutter-cycle {
      0%, 46%, 51%, 100% { opacity: 0; }
      47.5% { opacity: .55; }
      49% { opacity: .1; }
    }
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      .manual-camera .mc-iris-blade, .manual-camera .mc-focus, .manual-camera .mc-shutter-glint { animation: none; }
      .manual-camera .mc-iris-blade { transform: translateY(-12px); }
      .manual-camera .mc-focus { opacity: .65; }
      .manual-camera .mc-shutter-glint { opacity: 0; }
    }
  </style>
